title: pinus canadensis var. alba
intro: Pinus canadensis var. alba, commonly known as White Eastern White Pine, is a variety of the Eastern White Pine tree, native to the eastern regions of North America. The health benefits of White Eastern White Pine include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory issues, and support the immune system due to its antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to relieve coughs, colds, and other respiratory issues. Bioactive constituents of White Eastern White Pine include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
